name: Ketos Gou ni Matsuwaru Kiroku
original_name: ケートス号にまつわる記録
source:
The deranged unmanned submarine, "Ketos."
Once a vessel that ended wars, she had now become a singer of songs that drive people mad.
In order to monitor the Ketos, humanity sends out a submarine carrying death row inmates...
